correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the collision criterion and counted all maximizing site sets; reassessed the corrected RESULT.md and SLOGAN.txt. Deletions at i<j coincide exactly when the intervening comparison gives period two on positions i+2 through j+3. The adjacent equal inner letters of the palindrome at j join the two parity classes, and the palindrome at i extends the equality to i and i+1. So precisely the consecutive runs of sites index parents. The packing bound is tight by the unequal-letter period-four word. If the site path has odd length, all its alternating even sites must be legal, which forces the entire period-four word. If the site path has 2t positions, t≥2, a doubleton would use all slack: another run starts at i−2 or i+3 relative to the doubleton i,i+1. Those equalities force the missing separator legal and merge runs. With singleton runs only, the spare position is an extra end space or one double separator, giving exactly the displayed S_j. Each end choice has q²(q−1) words, with the unused site ruled out by its unequal middle pair. At the junction xuuxvvx both omitted sites require x=u=v, and a block with at least two sites requires its two block letters distinct. This gives q³−q for the sole interior j when t=2, two interior choices of q²(q−1) and t−3 choices of q(q−1)² for t≥3. Both sums give the claimed odd census; at N=4 and N=5 the separate counts follow by direct palindrome counting or inclusion–exclusion. Counting legal sites minus adjacent legal pairs proves the incidence formula for all N≥4. The supplied checker and saved output were inspected but not executed; the correctness decision is based on the complete symbolic argument.

originality.rationale: For the corrected extremizer census, particularly the odd-length count and its junction constraints. The frozen broad novelty framing included an exact maximum which is a direct packing specialization of prior work plus a witness, and stated an aggregate incidence also appearing verbatim in an equivalent later indexed result. The corrected finding credits and separates both, as well as the collision lemma. Neither inspected primary text nor either later catalogue match supplies the nontrivial odd-site rigidity and parity-dependent maximizing-word census. The possible derivation from an exact per-word formula still needs that separate combinatorial classification, not merely parameter substitution.
residual_risks: The bounded catalogue and primary comparisons do not exclude an unindexed equivalent extremizer census.

value.rationale: The size of the worst inverse list alone does not tell how rare the worst received words are. The census answers that directly for every alphabet and received length, with a natural parity contrast and exact junction constraints. It is valuable as a distributional extremal invariant of this channel, without requiring a new code construction or counting the known upper bound as a gain.
